109.socialEn: It vividly describes extra energy or drive.
109.socialZh: 這個說法生動地形容額外的精力或動力。
109.wrong1En: It solemnly describes exhaustion after all energy has been used up.
109.wrong1Zh: 它嚴肅地形容精力用盡後的疲倦。
109.wrong2En: It is a neutral report about the amount of petrol in a vehicle.
109.wrong2Zh: 它是關於車內汽油量的中性報告。

110.toneZh: 中性語域；負面人際關係
110.socialEn: It describes lingering hostility between people or groups.
110.socialZh: 這個說法形容人或群體之間持續的敵意。
110.wrong1En: It warmly celebrates the affection between the people involved.
110.wrong1Zh: 它溫暖地讚頌當事人之間的感情。
110.wrong2En: It diagnoses a blood disorder rather than describing a relationship.
110.wrong2Zh: 它診斷血液疾病，而非描述關係。

111.socialEn: It stresses a perfect fit, literally or figuratively.
111.socialZh: 這個說法強調實際或比喻上的完全合適。
111.wrong1En: It dismisses the fit as inadequate and disappointing.
111.wrong1Zh: 它批評尺寸不合適，令人失望。
111.wrong2En: It praises the object's low price without commenting on its fit.
111.wrong2Zh: 它讚揚物品價錢低廉，沒有評論是否合適。

meaning.meaningEn: Fit perfectly in size or shape, or suit a person or situation extremely well.
meaning.meaningZh: 大小或形狀完全合適；也可比喻非常適合某人或某種情況。

112.toneZh: 非正式；較舊式的英式說法
112.socialEn: It emphatically expresses the speaker's certainty.
112.socialZh: 這個說法強烈表達說話者的肯定。
112.wrong1En: It cautiously admits that the speaker has almost no confidence.
112.wrong1Zh: 它審慎地承認說話者幾乎毫無信心。
112.wrong2En: It reports a laboratory finding about eggs without expressing certainty.
112.wrong2Zh: 它報告關於雞蛋的實驗結果，沒有表達肯定。

113.socialEn: It describes confusion or disorganisation, often after disruption.
113.socialZh: 這個說法形容混亂或缺乏組織的狀態，常見於秩序受擾後。
113.wrong1En: It praises the team's calm organisation and clear priorities.
113.wrong1Zh: 它讚揚團隊組織冷靜，優先次序清晰。
113.wrong2En: It neutrally states the exact number of people present.
113.wrong2Zh: 它中性地陳述在場人數。

meaning.meaningEn: Confused, disorganised or unsure what to do.
meaning.meaningZh: 混亂、缺乏組織或無所適從。

114.toneZh: 日常用語；舒適與困難的對比
114.socialEn: It often appears in negatives to warn that life is not entirely easy.
114.socialZh: 這個說法常用於否定句，提醒生活並非全然輕鬆。
114.wrong1En: It is a botanical description rather than a comment on how easy life is.
114.wrong1Zh: 它是植物學描述，而非評論生活是否輕鬆。
114.wrong2En: It always celebrates hardship as the main pleasure of the situation.
114.wrong2Zh: 它總是把困難讚頌為處境中的主要樂趣。

115.socialEn: It emphasises a very high cost, often with disapproval.
115.socialZh: 這個說法強調費用極高，常帶不滿。
115.wrong1En: It warmly praises the price as a remarkable bargain.
115.wrong1Zh: 它熱情讚揚價錢非常划算。
115.wrong2En: It states an exact monetary amount without emphasis.
115.wrong2Zh: 它毫不強調地列出確實金額。

116.socialEn: It recommends or describes waiting before acting.
116.socialZh: 這個說法建議或描述行動前先等一等。
116.wrong1En: It urgently demands action without any pause.
116.wrong1Zh: 它急切要求毫不暫停地採取行動。
116.wrong2En: It declares that the plan has been permanently abandoned.
116.wrong2Zh: 它宣布計劃已永久放棄。

117.socialEn: It playfully acknowledges the arrival of someone just mentioned.
117.socialZh: 這個說法以玩笑口吻回應剛被提及的人出現。
117.wrong1En: It seriously accuses the arriving person of being morally evil.
117.wrong1Zh: 它認真指控到場者品行邪惡。
117.wrong2En: It formally orders the arriving person to leave immediately.
117.wrong2Zh: 它正式命令到場者立即離開。

118.socialEn: It describes following the prevailing direction without necessarily praising it.
118.socialZh: 這個說法描述跟隨主流走向，不一定帶讚賞。
118.wrong1En: It praises deliberate resistance to the prevailing trend.
118.wrong1Zh: 它讚揚刻意抗拒主流趨勢。
118.wrong2En: It guarantees that the majority's preference is morally right.
118.wrong2Zh: 它保證大多數人的偏好在道德上正確。

119.socialEn: It criticises someone for refusing to face an unpleasant reality.
119.socialZh: 這個說法批評某人拒絕面對不愉快的現實。
119.wrong1En: It praises a brave willingness to investigate unpleasant facts.
119.wrong1Zh: 它讚揚勇於調查不愉快事實的態度。
119.wrong2En: It neutrally describes a person who has never been told of the problem.
119.wrong2Zh: 它中性地描述一個從未獲告知問題的人。

120.socialEn: It describes revealing secret information, deliberately or accidentally.
120.socialZh: 這個說法描述有意或無意地洩露秘密。
120.wrong1En: It praises the successful protection of every secret.
120.wrong1Zh: 它讚揚成功保守所有秘密。
120.wrong2En: It necessarily accuses the person of deliberately lying.
120.wrong2Zh: 它必然指控當事人刻意說謊。

121.socialEn: It describes revealing a previously hidden plan or position.
121.socialZh: 這個說法描述透露之前隱藏的計劃或立場。
121.wrong1En: It celebrates keeping every intention concealed throughout the exchange.
121.wrong1Zh: 它讚揚整段交流中隱藏所有意圖。
121.wrong2En: It neutrally describes showing an injured hand to a doctor.
121.wrong2Zh: 它中性地描述向醫生展示受傷的手。

122.socialEn: It stresses that something is recorded in writing.
122.socialZh: 這個說法強調事情已有文字記錄。
122.wrong1En: It treats a spoken promise alone as sufficient written evidence.
122.wrong1Zh: 它把單純口頭承諾視為足夠的書面證據。
122.wrong2En: It guarantees the factual truth of whatever has been written.
122.wrong2Zh: 它保證任何已寫下的內容都是事實。

meaning.meaningZh: 清楚地以文字記錄下來。

123.toneZh: 日常用語；事後發現好處
123.socialEn: It reassesses an apparent setback in light of a later benefit.
123.socialZh: 這個說法根據後來的好處，重新看待原本似乎不利的事情。
123.wrong1En: It expresses regret that a welcome event later became harmful.
123.wrong1Zh: 它對原本令人歡迎的事情後來變得有害表示遺憾。
123.wrong2En: It guarantees in advance that every setback will benefit everyone.
123.wrong2Zh: 它事先保證每個挫折都會令所有人受益。

124.toneEn: Informal; chance rather than established skill
124.toneZh: 非正式；歸因於運氣而非已證實的技巧
124.socialEn: It attributes a newcomer's early success to luck, sometimes teasingly.
124.socialZh: 這個說法把新手初次成功歸因於運氣，有時帶玩笑意味。
124.wrong1En: It certifies the newcomer as an expert on the basis of proven long-term skill.
124.wrong1Zh: 它根據已證實的長期技巧，認定新手為專家。
124.wrong2En: It solemnly predicts that every future attempt will fail.
124.wrong2Zh: 它嚴肅預言未來每次嘗試都會失敗。

meaning.meaningEn: Unexpected early success attributed to chance rather than established skill.
meaning.meaningZh: 把新手初次的意外成功歸因於運氣，而非已證實的技巧。

125.socialEn: It describes admitting an error or accepting defeat after confidence or pride.
125.socialZh: 這個說法形容原本自信或自負的人後來認錯或認輸。
125.wrong1En: It proudly celebrates refusing to admit an error.
125.wrong1Zh: 它自豪地讚頌拒絕認錯。
125.wrong2En: It describes pleasure in proving someone else wrong without any embarrassment.
125.wrong2Zh: 它描述證明別人錯了的快感，毫無尷尬。

126.socialEn: It challenges a comparison because the things differ in relevant ways.
126.socialZh: 這個說法指出事物在重要方面不同，因此質疑比較是否公平。
126.wrong1En: It endorses the direct comparison because both things are identical.
126.wrong1Zh: 它認同直接比較，因為兩件事物完全相同。
126.wrong2En: It dismisses both things as worthless without discussing comparability.
126.wrong2Zh: 它說兩件事物都毫無價值，沒有討論是否可比較。

127.toneZh: 諺語式；勢均力敵的對抗
127.socialEn: It describes equally clever or skilful opponents confronting each other.
127.socialZh: 這個說法形容同樣精明或熟練的對手互相對抗。
127.wrong1En: It mocks a weak opponent who is easily defeated by an expert.
127.wrong1Zh: 它嘲笑被專家輕易擊敗的弱小對手。
127.wrong2En: It praises harmony between people who are not competing at all.
127.wrong2Zh: 它讚揚完全沒有競爭的人之間的和諧。

128.socialEn: It vividly expresses a person's intense happiness.
128.socialZh: 這個說法生動地表達極度快樂。
128.wrong1En: It solemnly describes severe grief and disappointment.
128.wrong1Zh: 它嚴肅地形容深切悲傷和失望。
128.wrong2En: It measures a person's literal height above the ground.
128.wrong2Zh: 它量度當事人實際離地的高度。

129.socialEn: It vividly describes feeling extremely happy.
129.socialZh: 這個說法生動地形容欣喜若狂的心情。
129.wrong1En: It expresses mild curiosity without any particular happiness.
129.wrong1Zh: 它表達輕微好奇，沒有特別快樂。
129.wrong2En: It objectively reports an aircraft's altitude.
129.wrong2Zh: 它客觀地報告飛機高度。

130.socialEn: It usually gives an informal estimate of very frequent occurrence.
130.socialZh: 這個說法通常以非正式方式表示事情發生得非常頻密。
130.wrong1En: It emphasises that the event is exceptionally rare.
130.wrong2En: It guarantees a scientifically measured percentage in every use.
130.wrong2Zh: 它保證每次使用都表示科學量度的百分比。

131.socialEn: It warns of or criticises a potentially fatal risk.
131.socialZh: 這個說法警告或批評可能致命的冒險。
131.wrong1En: It playfully describes a harmless inconvenience with no threat to life.
131.wrong1Zh: 它以玩笑口吻描述毫無生命威脅的小不便。
131.wrong2En: It calmly guarantees that the person will survive unharmed.
131.wrong2Zh: 它平靜地保證當事人會毫髮無損地生還。

132.socialEn: It accuses a display or explanation of misleading people.
132.socialZh: 這個說法指責某種展示或解釋有誤導作用。
132.wrong1En: It praises complete transparency and clear supporting evidence.
132.wrong1Zh: 它讚揚完全透明和清晰的支持證據。
132.wrong2En: It neutrally lists decorative materials without questioning honesty.
132.wrong2Zh: 它中性地列出裝飾材料，沒有質疑誠實程度。

133.socialEn: It describes nausea, which can have physical or emotional causes.
133.socialZh: 這個說法描述作嘔的感覺，原因可以是身體或情緒上的。
133.wrong1En: It describes ordinary hunger with no feeling of nausea.
133.wrong1Zh: 它描述普通肚餓，沒有作嘔感覺。
133.wrong2En: It guarantees that vomiting has already occurred.

134.socialEn: It describes a disruption to existing plans or arrangements.
134.socialZh: 這個說法描述原有計劃或安排受到擾亂。
134.wrong1En: It praises the preservation of every existing arrangement unchanged.
134.wrong1Zh: 它讚揚每項原有安排都維持不變。
134.wrong2En: It guarantees that the disruption will improve the result.
134.wrong2Zh: 它保證擾亂安排將改善結果。

135.socialEn: It describes wanting a particular outcome or thing very strongly.
135.socialZh: 這個說法描述非常渴望某個結果或事物。
135.wrong1En: It expresses indifference between all available choices.
135.wrong1Zh: 它表達對所有可用選擇都毫無偏好。
135.wrong2En: It announces that the desired outcome has already been obtained.
135.wrong2Zh: 它宣布渴望的結果已經得到。

136.socialEn: In this lesson it warmly describes someone lively and energetic.
136.socialZh: 在本課中，這個說法以親切口吻形容人精力充沛。
136.wrong1En: It criticises someone for being exhausted and inactive.
136.wrong1Zh: 它批評某人疲倦而不活躍。
136.wrong2En: It neutrally reports the person's most recent meal.
136.wrong2Zh: 它中性地報告當事人最近吃過的一餐。

137.socialEn: It describes assessing the direction of opinion or events.
137.socialZh: 這個說法描述判斷輿論或形勢的走向。
137.wrong1En: It asserts that current opinions and trends can safely be ignored.
137.wrong1Zh: 它斷言可以放心忽視當前意見和趨勢。
137.wrong2En: It guarantees an exact prediction of every future event.
137.wrong2Zh: 它保證能準確預測未來每件事。

138.socialEn: It describes an event as happening very rarely.
138.socialZh: 這個說法形容某事極少發生。
138.wrong1En: It emphasises a reliable event that happens every day.
138.wrong1Zh: 它強調一件每天穩定發生的事。
138.wrong2En: It states that the event is completely impossible.
138.wrong2Zh: 它表示事情完全不可能發生。
